notes: Stress test: Semester 1 report (no comparison), extreme aspect ratios, uncaptioned photos, a portrait pair. Fictional.

english.english_feedback: Jules listened closely to stories about animals and joined in with repeated phrases after hearing them a few times. In March, Jules pointed to the duck on each page and said “quack” before the adult turned the page. With a picture prompt, Jules told an adult two things that happened at the farm visit, and needed help to remember the order.

chinese.chinese_feedback: Jules喜欢在阅读角听老师讲故事。三月份，Jules能跟着老师说出“小猫”“小狗”等动物名称，并在提示下用“我要……”表达自己的需要。在点名活动中，Jules能用中文回应“到”，有时需要老师示范。
